TE4-F-01.hint: Label the sides opposite, adjacent, and hypotenuse relative to the given angle. Choose sine, cosine, or tangent by which two sides are involved. Find the other acute angle as \(90\text{°}\) minus the given angle.
slips: Having the calculator in radian mode when the angle is in degrees.
Choosing sine when the two sides involved are the opposite and the adjacent sides. That calls for tangent.
Rounding one side and then using the rounded value to find the next side.

TE4-A-01.hint: With two sides known, use the Pythagorean Theorem for the third side and an inverse trig function for an angle. Use the given values, not a rounded side, to find the angle.
slips: Using \(\sin\), \(\cos\), or \(\tan\) instead of the inverse function when finding an angle.
Choosing the wrong pair of sides for the ratio.
Having the calculator in radian mode.
